main_text.p: Ionicè tollitur, & aliquando geminatur incrementum, ut ὑμόμλω, τεπμόμλω. ἀπεχόμλω sustinui, fit ab ἀπέχω sustineo, sed velut ab ἀπαχέομαι: εἰλόμλω ab ἀιρέομαι capio: ἱκνόμλω perveni, ab ἱκνῦμαι: ἐγνόμλω, à γίγνομαι fio, sum. ab ἐρομαι interrogo, ἠρόμλω regulare est.
Aoristum 2 in μι, retinet figurativam thematis.
Sed aoristum hoc secundum in hoc verbo nō est usitatum: forma tamen conjugationis hinc patebit. Sic

page.notes: The Greek accents and breathings are faint on the scan; the Greek lines are copied as far as legible and may contain errors, especially in the verb forms. The signature mark at the foot is read as "q iij" and is doubtful. Some marks in the margins and at the foot are stains or show-through and were left out.
